test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Atul alone can complete a work in 114 days. How many persons were required with the same efficiency as Atul to complete the same work in 19 days?
solution:
Given:

Atul's time to complete the work = 114 days

Required time to complete the work = 19 days

**Concept:**

If each person works at the same speed, then the number of people required is inversely proportional to the time taken.

**Solution:**

Number of persons required = Atul's time/Required time ⇒ 114/19 = 6

**Therefore, 6 persons are required to complete the work in 19 days.**
